top_sensitivity.why: 21/420 wet hours can be removed before wet hours drop below 400

reasoning_path: rank high scores as small changes

rainfall_duration_shortened.threshold_basis: remove 21 of 420 wet hours to drop below 400 wet hours
rainfall_duration_shortened.diagnostic_effect: weakens the persistence leg of the long-duration rain diagnosis

rainfall_load_reduced.threshold_basis: reduce 393.6 mm hourly event rainfall to the 300 mm load threshold
rainfall_load_reduced.diagnostic_effect: breaks the heavy-rainfall load test before the daily total does

peak_wind_reinterpreted_as_primary.threshold_basis: increase local gust/catalog peak ratio from 0.264 to 0.50
peak_wind_reinterpreted_as_primary.diagnostic_effect: would make a local wind-only reading more competitive with rain-lag evidence

pressure_signal_weakened.threshold_basis: weaken the 11.4 hPa hourly pressure range to the 5 hPa threshold
pressure_signal_weakened.diagnostic_effect: reduces local storm-passage support but leaves rainfall and lag evidence intact

flood_lag_removed.threshold_basis: move the 34.0 h flood lag to the 72 h short-lag cutoff
flood_lag_removed.diagnostic_effect: removes the short delayed-flood timing link

gridded_rainfall_context_weakened.threshold_basis: weaken the lower CHIRPS max/mean ratio from 2.719 to 2.0
gridded_rainfall_context_weakened.diagnostic_effect: makes the regional rainfall maximum less robust across gridded products

criteria.name: Final ranking JSON
criteria.description: Provides the requested compact JSON fields, names rainfall_duration_shortened as the top sensitivity, and lists all six ranked scenarios.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points if the structure is mostly present but the top scenario or one required ranking field is missing.

criteria.name: Duration, catalog, and lag evidence
criteria.description: Computes the 36 day WMO anchor, 33.75 day catalog duration, 2.25 day duration gap, Red catalog level, 250.0 km/h catalog wind, and 34.0 h Malawi flood lag.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points for mostly correct timing evidence with one missing catalog, report, or lag value.

criteria.name: Hourly and daily rainfall calculations
criteria.description: Computes 393.6 mm hourly rain, 420 of 912 wet hours, 36 wet days, 62 h longest wet run, 112.4/393.6 = 0.286, 146.7/393.6 = 0.373, 482.85 mm daily rain, and daily exceedance counts of 7 days >=25 mm and 2 days >=50 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for correct rainfall totals with minor rounding errors; give 1 point if only one rainfall timescale is used.

criteria.name: Wind, pressure, and gridded context
criteria.description: Computes the 65.9 km/h local gust, 0.264 gust-to-catalog ratio, 1005.3 to 1016.7 hPa pressure range of 11.4 hPa, GPM ratio 3.378, CHIRPS ratio 2.719, and CHIRPS/GPM mean ratio 1.049.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1-2 points if either the wind-pressure or gridded-rainfall calculations are correct but the other family is missing.

criteria.name: Scenario sensitivity scoring
criteria.description: Uses the threshold-crossing formula and reports scenario scores of 95.000, 76.220, 73.555, 47.222, 43.860, and 10.319 in the correct scenario order.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 3-4 points if the formula is right but one or two scores are rounded or ordered incorrectly; give 1-2 points for a qualitative ranking without reproducible margins.

criteria.name: Interpretation and rejected alternative
criteria.description: Explains that rainfall-duration shortening is most sensitive, while peak-wind reinterpretation is rejected because the local gust/catalog ratio would need an about 89.7% increase to reach 0.50.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point if the interpretation is broadly consistent but omits either the top-sensitivity margin or the rejected wind margin.
